title: feat(console): a stored view filter's OR group filters the list, and the filter builder saves and reads it
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXa2W2ZCA4huS5hVVx

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuGBQqN3aajjckW6FfNNC6z5)_

Fixes #28370

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #28476 — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已存视图筛选里的「或」分组 `{ or: [规则...] }` 现在会真正筛出数据（列表、导出、看板、日历、相关列表等都生效）；筛选器里切到「或」可以保存成视图，再打开时仍是「或」。
- 为什么改：spec 已允许存这种分组，但控制台不认识它，带分组的视图加载时报筛选格式错误、一条记录都不显示；筛选器也拒绝保存「或」。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台对分组的读写；没有分组的筛选与之前逐字节相同。组与其他条件并列时，Studio 筛选器只读显示（防止保存丢条件），需在元数据里编辑。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts`（`toFilterNode` 把分组降为 `or` 节点）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts`（「或」保存为一个分组）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts`（视图覆盖清洗不再丢分组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/view-filter-or-group-28370.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全绿（分组降为 `or` 节点，内存数据源按「任一」筛出 a、b、e）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A view filter list element `{ or: [rule, ...] }` (`ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`, spec half #28380) is read by every console path that lowers, saves or reads back a stored view filter. Element kinds are told apart by the spec's own `isViewFilterOrGroup`; no reader restates the test.

**Query lowering.**
- `@object-ui/core` `toFilterNode`: a group becomes an `or` node of its rules (one member: that rule's node), one child of the list's implicit AND. Members go through `viewFilterRuleToNode`, so the operator fold, the arity check and the `icontains` comparand refusal apply inside a group as at the top level. A shape the spec refuses (empty `or`, non-array `or`, a blank-field member, a group inside a group) is returned as it arrived, an object in AST position that the server refuses with `400 INVALID_FILTER`, never repaired or dropped. This one sink covers `buildEffectiveFilter` (list fetch and export), `ObjectView` (kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline), `toFilterNodeSafely` (related list, line items, grid) and `ValueDataSource`.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` translator (both `find()` routes): a list opening with a group is recognised as the entry form; a group entry becomes `['or', ...tuples]`; a group spread into an `and` is translated when every member is a usable rule. A group that does not translate at the top level is refused whole with `MalformedFilterError` (`INVALID_FILTER`, 400). It used to ship a list opening with a group raw, and refuse a later group as an entry with no `field`.

**Save.** `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules`: `logic: 'or'` over two or more rules folds to `[{ or: rules }]` instead of refusing with `or_logic`. Fewer than two rules still fold flat; a nested group is still refused (`nested_group`). The `or_logic` reason and its message `console.objectView.filterOrNotSavable` are retired in all ten packs.

**Read back.**
- New `@object-ui/core` export `builderRulesOfSpecFilter(stored)`: a stored list as the one-level builder's logic over flat rules: AND for plain rules, OR for a list that is exactly one group, `null` for anything else carrying a group.
- `parseSpecFilter` / `toFilterGroup` (`@object-ui/plugin-view`) read a lone group as an OR group of its rules.
- The Studio `filter-builder` field (`metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`, also used for view tabs and the page block inspector) seeds the builder from `builderRulesOfSpecFilter`, so a stored group opens with OR and an edit writes the group back. A list with a group beside other conditions is shown with its fields named and the trigger disabled, titled with `console.objectView.filterOrGroupNotEditable` (new, all ten packs): loading it into a one-level builder would drop part of it on the next save.

**Other readers of a stored filter list.**
- `sanitizeViewOverride` (`objectViewTabs.ts`) dropped every group as an entry with no `field`, so a stored override with an OR group lost it on read and the view widened. A group is now judged by its members: unfinished members leave it, a group with none left is dropped, a malformed `or` is kept for the server to refuse.
- The Studio list-view inspector's `fieldNamesHeldBy` counts a group's member fields as fields the view references.
- `PageBlockInspector`'s filter field passes the element type through.

**Docs.** `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` gains a Base filter section with the any-of group and the builder's behaviour.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-wthww8`, not `claude/issue-28370-*`; the card is #28370.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/view-filter-or-group-28370.test.ts` (new, 13): fixtures parse as spec elements; a lone group, a group beside a rule (nested in the AND) and the HotCRM "open, or completed in the last 7 days" shape lowered and put through `isFilterAST` / `parseFilterAST`; one-member group; a refused member throws `FilterOperatorError` and `toFilterNodeSafely` answers `ok: false`; four refused shapes stay refused by `isFilterAST`; `mergeFilterNodes` with a user filter; `ValueDataSource` row sets for a group and a group ANDed with a rule; `builderRulesOfSpecFilter` cases.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/filter-or-group-28370.test.ts` (new, 10): group alone, first, last and spread, on both routes, with the wire parsed by the spec; three untranslatable groups refused with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 on both routes.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterOrGroup.roundTrip-28370.test.tsx` (new, 10): fold → `ListViewSchema` accepts → `toFilterGroup` reads OR → folds to the same body; AND control; the Studio widget opens a stored group as OR and writes edits back as the group, toggles AND ↔ OR between flat rules and one group, and shows a mixed list read-only with every field named and nothing written; `sanitizeViewOverride` keeps, trims and drops groups.
- Moved pins: `viewFilterFold.test.ts`, the two `or_logic` refusal cases now pin the fold to one group, and the reason list is `nested_group` only; two operator reads cast the folded element to a rule (type only).

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's `ui/packages/types/src/record-components.ts` rider (the related-list `filter` and `add.picker.filter` mirror) is NOT in this PR, by the seat's ruling: widening it type-breaks `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, whose two prop types (`filter`, `picker.filter`) are held by another card thread. Runtime is unaffected: the related list lowers through `toFilterNodeSafely`. Follow-up: #28462.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is now for the new `@object-ui/core` export `builderRulesOfSpecFilter` and its type `BuilderFilterRules`, not for the deferred rider.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: what a metadata author can write is unchanged (the spec half admitted the group); this PR makes the console apply it.
- Spec follow-up (`packages/spec`, not touched here): `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`'s describe and TSDoc still say `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and that the list is refused when it loads. Once this lands, a one-line spec edit drops the marker and that sentence.
- Not handled: a mixed list (a group beside other conditions) cannot be edited in the Console builder; it is applied, shown read-only, and editable in metadata. The builder has no sub-group control.

Head `cfd88e75` adds one commit on top: the changeset's Skills-docs line names #28476 and a type alias moves above a docblock in `PageBlockInspector.tsx` (no behaviour change; changeset gates and that file's eslint re-run, exit 0). All test runs under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared 4-core box.

- New tests: core 13/13, data-objectstack 10/10, app-shell round trip 10/10.
- Package suites: `core`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-view`, `i18n`: 508 files, 7634 passed, 40 skipped, 0 failed.
- `app-shell`: the full 2012-file suite did not finish here (the container restarted mid-run), so the 434 test files that import a changed module, or sit in `views/metadata-admin/` or match `views/*ilter*` / `views/*bjectView*`, were run: 434 files, 3900 passed, 0 failed. CI runs the full suite.
- Type-check: `type-check` in all five touched packages, exit 0 (app-shell after the two test casts in `4699b9fb`). `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: 0 raw tsc errors, no ledger entry above its number.
- ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors (warnings only; `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` keeps its existing inline `no-console` allowances).
- Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): core group lowering `return group` → 7 of 13 red; adapter group translation `return null` → 8 of 10 red; fold OR → flat rules → 4 of 10 red; `sanitizeViewOverride` group branch off → 2 of 10 red.

- Does not touch `ui/packages/types/**`, including the related-list mirror pins `related-list-add-picker-filter-mirror-9964.test.ts` and `related-list-filter-rule-array-10199.test.ts`.
- Dogfood: not owed (no `packages/spec` or protocol change; the console path is pinned in jsdom).
